## 📋 Checklist

**Before Submitting:**
- [ ] Searched existing issues (no duplicate)
- [ ] Provided minimal reproducible example
- [ ] Included error logs/screenshots
- [ ] Checked if bug exists in latest `main` branch

**For Maintainers:**
- [ ] Bug confirmed (reproduced locally)
- [ ] Root cause identified
- [ ] Fix implemented
- [ ] Tests added (to prevent regression)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
